passive.name: Marked Quarry
passive.desc: Basic attacks mark their target up to 3 times. Each mark adds Crit against that target; Arrow Storm consumes all marks for extra damage.

ultimate.name: Arrow Storm
ultimate.desc: Four rapid arrows dealing roughly 340% total damage to the entire pack.

passive.name: Arcane Reservoir
passive.desc: Uses Mana. Channel Bolt builds it; Arcane Lance spends it, converts half of Echo Strike chance into bonus damage, and applies Lifesteal. Arcane Surge is a Signature Burst: each basic or Echo strike has your Signature Burst chance to deal 50% more damage.

ultimate.name: Starfall
ultimate.desc: A 300% meteor that strikes the entire pack and restores 20% of damage dealt.

passive.name: Counterstance
passive.desc: Guarding primes the Fighter's next basic attack for a heavy counterblow.

ultimate.name: Titan Cleave
ultimate.desc: A 260% cleave that hits up to two enemies and grants a Battle Barrier.

passive.name: Flowing Combo
passive.desc: Consecutive basic attacks build Combo, increasing damage, Echo chance and Dodge. Guarding or drinking a potion resets it.

ultimate.name: Hundred Fists
ultimate.desc: A storm of blows dealing 325% damage and restoring 10% max HP.

passive.name: Opening Gag
passive.desc: Every battle begins with a random comedy gimmick: shoes, pies, barriers, applause or chickens.

ultimate.name: Final Punchline
ultimate.desc: A wildly variable area catastrophe that always grants a bonus effect.

passive.name: Painted Hexcraft
passive.desc: Uses Mana. Crimson Stroke builds it; Scarlet Hex spends it on violent battle-art magic.

ultimate.name: Crimson Deluge
ultimate.desc: A 310% scarlet strike with powerful innate lifesteal.

passive.name: Blood Rage
passive.desc: Every 1% missing HP grants +1% damage as Rage. The bar fills as your HP falls.

ultimate.name: Ragequake
ultimate.desc: An area smash dealing 280% damage. Your current Rage multiplies it like all other Berserker damage.

turtle.name: Turtle
turtle.unlock: Reach more than 40 Defense during a run

passive.name: Shell Discipline
passive.desc: Guarding primes a crushing shell counter on the next basic attack. Starts with an extra Barrier and +1 Defense.

ultimate.name: Shellquake
ultimate.desc: An area shell slam dealing 240% damage and granting two barriers.

frog.name: Frog
frog.unlock: Reach 150% Echo Strike during a run

passive.name: Predatory Bounce
passive.desc: Echo-heavy attacks become especially vicious against enemies below half HP.

ultimate.name: Croak Cascade
ultimate.desc: Six jumping strikes that independently target living enemies.

passive.name: Probability Leak
passive.desc: Nearly every combat action rolls a visible d20. The class intentionally pauses so you can witness fate making mistakes.

ultimate.name: Natural Twenty
ultimate.desc: Roll the action d20, then release a wildly scaling reality burst.

passive.name: Borrowed Shapes
passive.desc: Has no privileged mechanic of its own. Instead it can learn many non-Ultimate class powers from other non-secret classes.

ultimate.name: Ooze Everything
ultimate.desc: A 270% wave of slime that strikes the entire enemy pack.

vampire.name: Vampire
vampire.unlock: Exceed 100% Lifesteal and defeat the Board 3 final boss

passive.name: Night Hunger
passive.desc: Uses Mana for occult attacks while retaining extreme Lifesteal. Grave Lance converts spell damage back into health.

ultimate.name: Crimson Eclipse
ultimate.desc: Drain the entire pack for heavy damage and heal for 50% of damage dealt.

ninja.name: Ninja
ninja.unlock: Reach more than 100% Critical chance during a run

passive.name: Smoke Counter
passive.desc: Critical hits build Smoke. At 3 Smoke, the next basic attack becomes a defense-piercing execution strike.

ultimate.name: Thousand Shadows
ultimate.desc: Five independently critical strikes against the selected enemy, spilling to new targets on defeat.

passive.name: Executive Compensation
passive.desc: All gold gained is increased by +200%. Secret classes are allowed to be financially irresponsible.

ultimate.name: Quarterly Annihilation
ultimate.desc: A boardroom-wide attack scaling with Boss Damage and current gold.

merchant.name: Merchant
merchant.unlock: Defeat the Road Merchant secret boss once
merchant.stats: 52 HP · 10 ATK · 25/100 MANA · 20 LUCK · GOLD SCALING

passive.name: Occult Accounting
passive.desc: Selling unused gear pays 200% normal value. Ledger Tap and Foreclosure Hex also use Mana.

ultimate.name: Market Monopoly
ultimate.desc: Deals massive pack damage, grants gold and raises two barriers.

passive.name: Faith
passive.desc: Healing builds Faith. At full Faith, the Cleric can cast a free Consecration during combat.

ultimate.name: Divine Reckoning
ultimate.desc: Holy area damage plus a large self-heal. Overhealing can interact with effects that explicitly allow it.

paladin.name: Paladin
paladin.unlock: Defeat Board 3 with both Fighter and Cleric

passive.name: Oathplate
passive.desc: Defense contributes 35% of its value to ordinary attack damage. The class remains deliberately stable and dependable.

ultimate.name: Aegis Judgment
ultimate.desc: Heavy holy area damage scaling with Attack and Defense, heals the Paladin and feeds Oath Grace, then raises barriers.

beastmaster.name: Beastmaster
beastmaster.stats: 48 HP · 7 ATK · 1 DEF · STRONG PET SCALING

passive.name: Pack Orders
passive.desc: Can switch its companion between Aggressive, Defensive and Support stances during battle.

ultimate.name: Call of the Pack
ultimate.desc: Calls a spectral pack for area damage based on Attack plus several times your active companion's damage.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.unlock: Hold 5,000 gold at one time and defeat the Board 3 miniboss

passive.name: Sticky Fingers
passive.desc: Can attempt to Steal once per battle for gold and occasionally a potion. Above 50 Luck, successful Steals can also snatch a random powerup. Starts with +25% gold gain and +5% Dodge.

ultimate.name: Grand Larceny
ultimate.desc: A brutal single-target strike that steals gold after the hit.

bloodmage.name: Bloodmage
bloodmage.unlock: Secret: defeat the Bloodmage hidden inside a Bloodwell

passive.name: Blood Is Mana
passive.desc: Uses HP where other occult classes use Mana. Bloodletting restores fuel; Exsanguinate spends life for brutal damage; Replenish heals both sides.

ultimate.name: Sanguine Cataclysm
ultimate.desc: Deals heavy damage to every enemy, then restores a portion of the blood spilled.

passive.name: Spirit Circle
passive.desc: Uses Mana to conjure up to three temporary companion spirits each battle. Summoned spirits attack after your normal companion.

ultimate.name: Grand Convergence
ultimate.desc: Calls a temporary full spirit circle and sends every summoned familiar crashing through the enemy pack.

pokemontrainer.name: Pokémon Trainer
pokemontrainer.unlock: Secret: raise every companion to level 10 and clear Board 5 with Beastmaster on any difficulty

passive.name: Six-Creature Draft
passive.desc: At run start, six companions are randomly drafted into a roster. The active roster creature attacks much harder and may call an assist.

ultimate.name: Six-Pack Stampede
ultimate.desc: Every creature in the six-member roster attacks the entire pack in rapid succession.

passive.name: Combat Distillery
passive.desc: Every third basic attack brews a potion. Potions can heal normally or be consumed as Volatile Flasks whose damage scales with Potion Healing.

ultimate.name: Grand Distillation
ultimate.desc: Creates three potions, restores health and detonates an oversized restorative formula across the enemy pack.

ouroboros.name: Ouroboros
ouroboros.unlock: Secret: reach 400% Echo Strike during a run

ultimate.name: Infinite Return
ultimate.desc: A chain of serpent strikes whose hit count scales with Echo Strike. Every hit adds Poison and can bounce through the pack.

ultimate.name: Dragon Dive
ultimate.desc: A direct, decisive aerial dive against the selected target that uses the normal Ultimate and elemental rules.

invoker.name: Invoker
invoker.unlock: Cast 100 Mana-spender spells across your career.

ultimate.name: Invoke
ultimate.desc: At 100 Ultimate, invoke the spell determined by your current three-orb formula.

slimerouge.name: Slime Rouge
slimerouge.unlock: Secret: clear Board 6 after beginning the run with Random while Slime is already unlocked
slimerouge.stats: 44 HP · 7 ATK · 1 DEF · RANDOM IDENTITY · RANDOM ULTIMATE

ultimate.name: Stolen Finale
ultimate.desc: A random unlocked class ultimate is selected independently at the beginning of every run and executes with the donor class's real behavior.

invoker.name: Orb Invocation
invoker.desc: Defend forms Blue, Mana generation forms Green, and Mana spending forms Red. Three active orbs empower you and define Invoke.

result.text: 🗡️ Pocket Dummy catches your hand. You steal absolutely nothing.
☀️ Consecration spends 100 Faith, heals 22 HP, raises a Barrier and deals 54 Light-touched damage across the pack.

🧪 Volatile Flask consumes restorative potency as violence for 93 total damage.

recipe.name: Deafening Blast
recipe.tip: 165% AoE; next response deals 35% less damage and delays a special.
